title: xdrip shows the same bolus twice.
body:
Using openaps, with two raspberry pis.
Son enters 15 carbs using medtronic pump. Xdrip shows them twice.
Here are the relevant lines from the xdrip db:

Correction estimate 0
Bolus estimate 1.8
Target low 110
Target high 111

Correction estimate 0

comments.body:
Seems like similar thing has happened.
Issue is probably with openaps, not xdrip.
Seems that there are two pills in nightscout as well. They are just covering each other.
It seems to be caused by going over the wizard once, but without actually bolusing.
Still carbs are being counted twice...
